name: Empowered Solar
old_description: Empowered Solar is an Idaho company designing and installing solar electric systems for residential and commercial customers. When you choose to do business with Empowered Solar you get professional local service and can feel confident that you are making a sound investment financially and environmentally. We provide solar panel installation for both roof mounted and ground mounted systems. We size each solar installation to fit the client's energy needs. Take control of your energy usage by calling us for a free quote today.
about:
Empowered Solar operates from Boise, Idaho, where it designs and installs solar electric systems for residential and commercial customers. The company was established as an Idaho-based business focused on providing professional local service for solar installations.

The firm handles both roof-mounted and ground-mounted solar panel installations, sizing each system to match the client's energy requirements. It procures high-quality solar panels, inverters, and mounting systems backed by industry-leading warranties, and manages the full installation process from design to commissioning.

Empowered Solar serves homeowners and businesses across Idaho. Residential customers can take advantage of the 30% federal renewable energy tax credit, while commercial clients receive custom solutions for on-site electricity generation. The company also assists with state tax deductions and low-interest loan programs.

The company states that its business model aims to be a force for change locally and in developing countries, partnering with non-profits to extend clean energy access. It emphasizes that customers receive a sound financial and environmental investment through professional local service.
